newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks and Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks and Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday as Audi shares rose to $16.625 from $16.5 on Friday and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares held steady at $12.
Lebanon's banks and financial markets were closed on Monday for the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday which marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.625 from $10.5 while B shares were unchanged at $11.25.

Turnover in BLC was 1,000 shares from 2,000 and 33,750 Audi shares changed hands against 31,043 on Friday. Tuesday's turnover in Audi included a block of 14,750 shares traded outside the BSE at $16.25.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 85,150 shares for a value of $1,038,600 against 98,673 shares for a value of $1,124,205.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.45 percent to 923.52 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.19 percent to 81.32.
